claims: The film Sinners won four Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.
Sinners received a record-breaking 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners set a record for most losses with 12 at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan played twins Smoke and Stack in Sinners.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win Best Cinematography.
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Song for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners is a period vampire thriller.
Sinners highlights the origins of the Blues.
